Welcome to the official online profile of Amb. Major Prophet Wisdom Kpooge, also known as Mene Bari 1 of Africa.

Born on 23 September 1983 in Barako Community, Gokana Local Government Area, Rivers State, Nigeria, Amb. Major Prophet Wisdom Kpooge is also known as Mene Bari 1 of Africa. This profile introduces his ministry and connects visitors with the work of Omega Praise and Miracle Center (OPMC).

Explore his ministry profile, teachings, ministry updates, and opportunities to connect with Omega Praise and Miracle Center (OPMC).

Ministry focus

The ministry focuses on biblical teaching, prayer and intercession, prophetic ministry, healing and deliverance messages, evangelism, outreach, and encouragement for spiritual growth. On 10 October 2025, Amb. Major Prophet Wisdom Kpooge received the UN Ambassador for Peace award.

Biblical Teaching Prayer Prophetic Ministry Evangelism Spiritual Growth

Omega Praise and Miracle Center

Omega Praise and Miracle Center (OPMC) was established in 2021 and is located in Eteo Community, Eleme Local Government Area, Rivers State, Nigeria. Visitors can learn about church services, ministry programmes, announcements, and ways to participate in the life of the church.

What We Stand For

Our mission and heart

Our ministry vision is centered on the Gospel of Jesus Christ and helping people live out their faith.

✦

Preach the Gospel

Share the message of Jesus Christ and nurture a life-changing relationship with God.

✧

Healing and Deliverance

Provide prayer and spiritual support for those seeking healing, freedom, restoration, and renewed hope through faith in God.

✧

Build Faith

Encourage believers to grow through biblical teaching, prayer, holiness, and the work of the Holy Spirit.

♡

Restore Hope

Offer prayer, encouragement, and spiritual support to individuals and families seeking renewed hope.

⌂

Strengthen Families

Encourage godly homes, caring relationships, and a community grounded in faith.

☼

Prayer and Ministry

Create opportunities for people to pray together, seek God, and grow in spiritual understanding.

➤

Live with Purpose

Equip people through discipleship and biblical teaching to follow Christ faithfully.
